name: OpenFlux Official Curated List
description: Curated v2 default modules — every background, key press effect, widget, and roaming companion built on the public OpenFlux module API.

entries.name: Aurora Velvet Shader
entries.description: Animated bioluminescent aurora background shader designed for 3D water refraction

entries.name: 3D Water Ripple
entries.description: Real-time 2D wave simulation refracting whatever video or shader is playing underneath

entries.name: Analog Depth & Velocity Glow
entries.description: Spreads wide beneath neighboring keys on the way down and contracts gently on the way up

entries.name: Key-Bouncing & Refracting Particles
entries.description: Particles bounce down 2mm keycap trenches or pass under clear keycaps with optical magnification

entries.name: Idle Pet Companion
entries.description: Hangs out in a top-bar slot, swipes at typing, startles at ripples, and roams across physical keycaps sending surface impulses

entries.name: Clock Widget
entries.description: Keyboard-standalone digital clock with seconds arc

entries.name: System Load Widget
entries.description: Hybrid CPU/RAM/GPU telemetry bar with graceful standalone fallback

entries.name: Now Playing Widget
entries.description: Live media playback title, artist, equalizer, and progress

entries.name: Weather Widget
entries.description: Hybrid weather tile with secret-stripped optional API key setting

entries.name: Pomodoro Timer
entries.description: Standalone Pomodoro timer that emits a celebratory surface impulse on completion
